title: Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
headline: SDAR: treats On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) as a gated auxiliary objective alongside RL. Adds dense token-level supervision from a privileged-context teacher branch to the trajectory-level RL signal, but gates the distillation loss to handle multi-turn agentic instability.
abstract_preview: RL has emerged as the central paradigm for post-training LLM agents, but its trajectory-level reward provides only coarse supervision for long-horizon interaction. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) complements RL with dense token-level guidance from a privileged teacher branch — but transferring OPSD to multi-turn agents is problematic (compounding instability + asymmetric treatment for negative teacher rejections). SDAR keeps RL as the primary optimization backbone and treats OPSD as a gated auxiliary objective.
